correctness.rationale: Direct Katětov triangle restrictions make distinct clusters independent, yielding the exact trivariate factor. Any multiplicative relation in \(M_j=2^j-1\) is eliminated from its maximal differing index by Bang-Zsigmondy except index six, where elementary 3- and 7-adic valuations give precisely \(M_6=M_2^2M_3\). This operation changes total parameter count by one and cluster count by two; hence either datum enforces uniqueness. Direct literal diagram checks agree for 44 partition profiles; all 28,628 partitions through \(n=30\) have distinct scalar count at fixed \(n\); every checked collision \(\le 1{,}000{,}000\) obeys the relation. Finite checks are not treated as proof of the infinite primitive divisor statement.

value.rationale: Reconstructing the complete finite parameter metric from a single extension-type count plus a minimal natural size datum is a structurally motivated inverse problem, and the theorem classifies every ambiguity without size information. The one exceptional move changes both the old cardinality and cluster number; thus the same scalar is complete at each fixed size while a different intercluster distance regime admits fixed-size collisions. The all-size theorem and sharp first ambiguity are not just finite enumeration or a change of notation.
